title: Bexar Property Data Profile
eyebrow: Bexar Appraisal District · Website data exports
intro: Everything Bexar Appraisal District gives us as bulk files, from three exports: the PACS Appraisal Export (18 files, two snapshots: the March 28 first-notice preliminary roll and the October 15 export as of supplement 298), the Agent Export (21 CSV files, October 26) and the Property Summary file (March 28 and October 13). The year switch on every tab picks the snapshot. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness, value distributions and 100 sample rows.
foot: Generated {date}. Files were scanned in full with DuckDB. The PACS files are converted from the raw fixed-width .TXT files to CSV using BCAD's own 8.0.34 layout workbook (the March export is 8.0.0.33, the same layout without the FEED fields); the Agent Export and Property Summary files are read as published. "Auto-detected on load" is the type DuckDB assigns, and distinct counts there are approximate (HyperLogLog). "Data type" is inferred from the values: Code means digits stored as text with leading zeros.

sources.label: PACS Appraisal Export
sources.sub: {n} files · every property in the county
sources.desc: BCAD's PACS Appraisal Export, provided on request through BCAD's FTP server (one zip per snapshot). Fixed-width .TXT files, converted to CSV for profiling with BCAD's own layout workbook; every property in the county. prop_id is the BCAD property id used by every other Bexar file.

groups.label: Property Roll
groups.desc: The main roll file, APPRAISAL_INFO. One row per prop_id and owner.

groups.label: Taxing Units
groups.desc: Values and exemptions split by taxing unit, plus roll totals per unit. Joins to the property roll on prop_id + owner_id. Pick an export, then a file.

groups.label: Improvements
groups.desc: Buildings and their segments, attributes, mobile-home detail. All join on prop_id, then imprv_id and imprv_det_id. Pick an export, then a file.

groups.label: Land
groups.desc: Land segments, from APPRAISAL_LAND_DETAIL. Joins to the property roll on prop_id.

groups.label: Protests & Agents
groups.desc: ARB protests, lawsuits, arbitration and the agent list. Pick an export, then a file.

groups.label: Code Lookups
groups.desc: Small lookup tables and the export header. Pick an export, then a file.

sources.label: Agent Export
sources.sub: {n} CSV files · every property in the county
sources.desc: BCAD's Agent Export as of October 26, 2026 (2026 Agent Export as of 2026-10-26.zip, headerless pipe-delimited .txt files, converted to CSV with the column names from BCAD's layout PDF; values are unchanged). Despite the name it covers every property in the county, and several files reach back to the 1990s. Property ID is the PACS prop_id. The Non-Agent Export of October 21 carries the same files minus the three sales files and is not profiled separately.

groups.label: Property
groups.desc: Property-level files from the Agent Export. All join on Property ID (PACS prop_id).

groups.label: Improvements & Income
groups.desc: Buildings, their segments and features, and income-approach records. Join on Property ID, then Improvement ID / Detail ID.

groups.label: Land
groups.desc: Land segments from the Agent Export, joined on Property ID.

groups.label: Sales
groups.desc: Sales and the land and improvements on the property at the time of sale. Join on Sale ID and Property ID.

groups.label: Business Personal Property
groups.desc: Business personal property (BPP) rendition segments and the link from each BPP account to its real property.

groups.label: Building Permits
groups.desc: Building permits and the properties they apply to. Join through Permit ID.

groups.label: Protests & Inquiries
groups.desc: ARB protests, informal inquiries, protesters and the letters sent on them, every year on file. Join on Property ID + Year + Case ID.

sources.label: Property Summary
sources.desc: BCAD's Property Summary Export, a flat one-row-per-property CSV (layout of 2025-09-04), in two snapshots.

groups.label: Property Summary
groups.desc: The flat Property Summary file. Joins to the PACS roll on Prop_id.
